name: Eleanor Vance
bio:
Eleanor Vance is a seasoned race engineer with nearly three decades of experience in motorsport. Her journey began with a degree in mechanical engineering from Imperial College London, followed by an apprenticeship at a small Formula Ford team. Her meticulous approach and innate understanding of vehicle dynamics quickly propelled her through the ranks. Eleanor's career highlights include several championship wins in various racing series, always prioritizing a data-driven methodology.

Joining Scuderia Ferrari was a lifelong ambition, representing the pinnacle of her career. She views her role as a careful balancing act between pushing the boundaries of performance and ensuring reliability. Eleanor is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to clearly communicate complex technical information to drivers and other team members. She is a firm believer in continuous improvement and fosters a culture of learning within her engineering group, focusing on marginal gains and innovative problem-solving.

What distinguishes Eleanor is her unwavering commitment to perfection. Her ability to dissect complex problems into manageable components, coupled with her pragmatic approach, makes her an invaluable asset to any racing team. She is deeply respected by her peers and the drivers she works with, renowned for her technical expertise and unwavering dedication.

physical.description: Eleanor is of average height with a slender build.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Carroll Smith's Tune to Win'.
Insists on having a perfectly organized toolbox.
Drinks Earl Grey tea precisely at 3 PM every day.
